cites.quote: T-10: the configured zone is assumed to be validated by the API before use.
Does GET /api/settings (read through useSettings) carry the hospital time zone HOSPITAL_TZ to the web app?

findings.text: The T-10 assumption that the API validates the configured zone before use has no basis, citation or question. The design itself only assumes settings carry the zone at all (design Q-05).

findings.text: Q-01 defaults to staff-only network access with no evidence. The deployment-shape section describes a Render-hosted API that serves the web app, which suggests public reachability, and the artifact does not cite it.
